name: Musike
description: Music player for YouTube Music's catalog, with genres, full albums and playlists

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your library: playlists, favorites and history (library.json). Back this folder up.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: HD music videos already downloaded. Safe to delete; it is limited to 2 GB by default.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Musike web player and API, published on host as 6189

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: MUSIKE_LOCATION
variables.description: Your country, as a two-letter code like US, GB, DE or IN. It decides which YouTube Music results and charts you see.
